title: Holy priest: a hired BOT Arms warrior forced to dps role in Battle Stance with no shield still gets a shield in the 21-50 % band (control for #1553)

rules.desc: Control: the holy priest shields a hired BOT Arms warrior (forced dps role, Battle Stance, no shield) at least once while it is between the critical and the low health band
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/HolyPriestStrategy.cpp:41-49 (party member low health: shield first); ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/PriestActions.h:42; ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504,520-576,597-611 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear / HasOtherTank / GetPlayerRoles); a forced dps role with an active master makes IsTank false (read-only investigation of runs 20261108-044040/-045710/-050750)
rules.why_expect: control: a bot warrior forced to dps role, in Battle Stance and with no shield is no tank on any build, so the guard must not fire and the priest shields it in the 21-50 % band. Expected PASS on t1106g and on the fix. If this FAILS the priest is not answering low-health party members at all (check player_visible and the bot's own visibility) and the 2TANK/DEF-ARMS results mean nothing

rules.desc: Precondition: the bot warrior stays in Battle Stance (aura 2457) through the fight, so the shield rule above is about a dps-role warrior in Battle Stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); the Arms strategy keeps Battle Stance
rules.why_expect: an Arms warrior bot fights in Battle Stance; a Defensive Stance here would make the control a tank and void it
